identity.title: NDFD GRIB2 Decoder Dependency Enablement
identity.objective: Add one isolated, deterministic, optional NDFD GRIB2 decoding dependency capability: the exact ECMWF ecCodes optional extra ndfd-grib (eccodes==2.48.0 on Python 3.12; eccodeslib==2.48.0.26 on non-Windows Python 3.12), one committed official NDFD CONUS PoP12 GRIB2 message fixture with frozen source/hash identity, a focused offline decode compatibility test with a frozen oracle and fingerprint, and dedicated ubuntu-24.04/windows-2022 Python 3.12 hosted CI plus a pip-audit job for the resolved closure. Resolves only the S10-QUAL-DATA-01 NDFD_DEPENDENCY_REQUIRED decoder blocker; no src/ change, no product/runtime network, no weather adapter, no qualification, credentials, paper, execution or live authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-NDFD-GRIB-01. The ndfd-grib optional extra, the two dedicated ndfd-grib CI jobs, the committed NDFD fixture, the focused/contract tests, the three spec-derived historical-guard corrections and the S10-NDFD-GRIB-01 docs/status/spec artifacts disappear. Base dependencies, the Python range, existing CI jobs, src/ and all runtime, evidence, order and capital state are untouched.

api_matrix.reason: No product or runtime API is added or changed; the decoder is exercised only by tests against a committed fixture.

semantic_fields.reason: These rules close the exact optional pins, unchanged base facts, binary-only install, fixture identity, decode oracle, supported matrix, fail-closed behavior, collection discipline, authority boundaries and successor boundary.
